name: al-agentic-dev

Two persistence layers: repo-root markdown (CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/, .out-of-scope/) and branch-scoped HTML specs (event-model.html + architecture.html + tasks.html). SKILLs express intent and rationale; the agent shapes output per situation. NEW in 0.24.0: SKILL.md and references rewritten in mattpocock style: rationale woven into the rule, no Why-paragraph blocks, plain-English section names. References consolidated: testability.md (three-phase decoupling + three seams + five doubles), tdd.md (cycle + ZOMBIES + mutation + invariants), voice-contract.md (absorbs chat shapes). Plugin prose cut by ~50%.
